module purpose: neorv32_spi is a bus-attached SPI host: a strobed bus write with address bit 2 = '0' stores the control settings (enable, clock phase and polarity, prescaler select, divider, high-speed, four interrupt enables) and a write with address bit 2 = '1' pushes a data byte or a chip-select command into a TX FIFO; a transceiver state machine paced by a divided clock tick shifts each byte out on spi_dat_o while sampling spi_dat_i, drives spi_clk_o and spi_csn_o, pushes the received byte into an RX FIFO that bus reads return, and raises irq_o from the enabled FIFO and idle conditions.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, cpha, cpol, prsc, cdiv, highspeed, irq_rx_avail, irq_tx_empty, irq_tx_nhalf, irq_idle) taken from bus write data and held in the ctrl fields

a transmit entry (data byte or chip-select command) pushed into the TX FIFO by a bus write, then popped by the idle, enabled engine, which either loads the chip-select command or loads the byte and begins a transfer
bit-rate tick: the divider counter advanced on a selected prescaler tick or in high-speed mode and the one-cycle tick spi_clk_en raised when it matches ctrl.cdiv
byte transfer: state sequencing, serial clock level, sampling of spi_dat_i, shifting of the shift register, bit counting, completion event and busy decision, with the data and clock driven out
chip-select state loaded from a command entry and decoded into one active-low select line
interrupt request formed from the enable and the enabled RX-available, TX-empty, TX-not-half-full and idle conditions
status bits (RX available, TX empty, TX not half full, TX full, chip-select active, busy) returned on a control read
stored control settings returned on a control read
received byte written into the RX FIFO on transfer completion and returned (with an RX FIFO pop) on a data read
control settings, interrupt, engine registers, chip selects and divider forced to constants while rstn_i is '0'
disable clear: with ctrl.enable = '0' both FIFOs are cleared, the engine leaves the active states and drops chip select, and the divider is held at zero
